title: Depression and Discouragement
definition: Depression and discouragement describe seasons of heaviness, sorrow, weariness, and loss of hope that must be met with truth, compassion, and dependence on God.
summary: God meets His people in deep discouragement with presence, truth, care, and hope.
christFocus: Jesus is gentle with the weary and gives rest to burdened souls.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture gives language for deep sorrow and discouragement. Many of God's people cried out from places of heaviness, fear, weariness, and confusion.

Depression and discouragement should be met with compassion, not shame. Spiritual truth matters, but it must be applied with patience and care. Sometimes people need rest, support, counsel, medical care, prayer, and steady companionship.

Christ is gentle with the weary. He does not crush the bruised reed but invites the burdened to come to Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Discouraged people often feel condemned for not being stronger. This doctrine matters because it brings biblical truth and tenderness together for those who are emotionally weary.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not suffer alone. Bring your discouragement to God, speak with trusted believers, seek wise help, and hold onto truth even when feelings are heavy.
